description: Buffer is a social media publishing and scheduling platform for managing channels, posts, ideas, and related analytics. It lets users and app developers automate publishing workflows and connect Buffer to external tools and AI assistants.
summary: Buffer exposes a GraphQL API at `https://api.buffer.com`, a remote MCP server at `https://mcp.buffer.com/mcp`, a `buffer` CLI (`@bufferapp/cli`), and a legacy REST API at `https://api.bufferapp.com/1/`; all documented developer surfaces require authentication.
